sentences.en: Gran came to stay.
sentences.zh: Gran 来到停留。

sentences.en: The children ran to meet her.
sentences.zh: 这孩子们跑到遇见她。

sentences.en: "Hooray!" Said Kipper.
sentences.zh: 哦帮助， 说 Kipper。

sentences.en: Said Kipper, "I love it when Gran comes to stay.
sentences.zh: Kipper， 我爱它当……时 Gran 来到停留。

sentences.en: She's good fun!"
sentences.zh: 她是好的乐趣！

sentences.en: Gran brought presents for everyone.
sentences.zh: Gran 带来礼物为了每个人。

sentences.en: She gave Mum and Dad an ornament.
sentences.zh: 她给妈妈和爸爸一个装饰。

sentences.en: Kipper had some little golf clubs and Biff and Chip had a keyboard.
sentences.zh: Kipper 有一些小的高尔夫球俱乐部和 Biff 和 Chip 有一个键盘。

sentences.en: "Thanks Gran," Said everyone.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你， Gran。 Gran， 说每个人。 哦不！

sentences.en: "I've another surprise for you," said Gran.
sentences.zh: 我已经另一个意想不到的事物为了你， 说 Gran。

sentences.en: She gave the children some funny-looking parcels.
sentences.zh: 她给这孩子们一些 funny-looking 包裹。

sentences.en: "What are they?" Asked Kipper.
sentences.zh: 什么是他们？ 问 Kipper。 什么是他们？ 问 Kipper。

sentences.en: "Boomerangs," Said Gran.
sentences.zh: 回飞镖， 说 Gran。 哦不！ 说 Gran。

sentences.en: The children wanted to see how the boomerangs worked.
sentences.zh: 这孩子们想要到看见如何这回飞镖工作。

sentences.en: Gran took them outside.
sentences.zh: Gran 拿他们外面。

sentences.en: She threw a boomerang and it whizzed through the air.
sentences.zh: 她扔一个回飞镖和它飕飕飞过穿过这空气。

sentences.en: "Look out!" Shouted Gran.
sentences.zh: 你看使苦恼。 看出！ 喊 Gran。

sentences.en: Kipper wanted to play with the golf clubs.
sentences.zh: Kipper 想要到玩和……一起这高尔夫球俱乐部。

sentences.en: Gran showed him what to do.
sentences.zh: Gran 展示他什么到做。

sentences.en: She hit the ball, but she hit it too hard and it smashed a window.
sentences.zh: 她击这球， 但是她击它也困难的和它严重损坏的一个窗户。

sentences.en: "Oh dear," Said Gran.
sentences.zh: 哦亲爱的， 说 Gran。 哦不！ 说 Gran。

sentences.en: Next day, Wilf, Wilma, Nadim and Anneena came to play.
sentences.zh: 下一个一天， Wilf， Wilma， Nadim 和 Anneena 来到玩。

sentences.en: Biff and Chip showed them the keyboard.
sentences.zh: Biff 和 Chip 展示他们这键盘。

sentences.en: Gran had a good idea.
sentences.zh: Gran 有一个好的主意。

sentences.en: "Let's have a band," she said.
sentences.zh: 让我们有一个乐队， 她说。

sentences.en: The band made a lot of noise and the children had a good time.
sentences.zh: 这乐队做一个许多的噪音和这孩子们有一个好的时间。

sentences.en: "Whatever will Gran do next?" Said Dad.
sentences.zh: 什么有我们做完？ Kipper， 说爸爸。

sentences.en: "She's worse than the children!" Said Mum.
sentences.zh: 她是更坏的比这孩子们！ 说妈妈。

sentences.en: Gran had promised to take the children on an outing.
sentences.zh: Gran 有承诺到拿这孩子们在……上一个出。

sentences.en: She said that Nadim and Anneena could go too.
sentences.zh: 她说那个 Nadim 和 Anneena 能去也。

sentences.en: "I'll take you all to London," she said.
sentences.zh: 我会拿你全部到伦敦， 她说。

sentences.en: "Look after Gran," said Mum as they got into the car.
sentences.zh: 看出！ 喊 Gran。

sentences.en: "Try and stop her getting into trouble."
sentences.zh: 尝试和停她得到进入问题。

sentences.en: "We'll do our best," Said Biff.
sentences.zh: 哇！ 说 Biff。

sentences.en: "But it won't be easy."
sentences.zh: Biff， 但是它不会是容易的。

sentences.en: When they got to London, Gran parked the car.
sentences.zh: 当……时他们得到到伦敦， Gran 公园这汽车。

sentences.en: "Now we'll take the tube," said Gran.
sentences.zh: 现在我们会拿这金属管， 说 Gran。 哦不！ 说 Gran。

sentences.en: "It's the best way to get around."
sentences.zh: 它是这最好的方式到得到在……周围。

sentences.en: No There were lots of people waiting on the platform.
sentences.zh: 不那里是许多的人们等在……上这舞台。

sentences.en: When the train came in everyone rushed to get on.
sentences.zh: 当……时这火车来在……里每个人仓促的到得到在……上。

sentences.en: "Now I know why it's called a tube," Said Anneena.
sentences.zh: 我知道为什么它是叫一个金属管， 说 Anneena， 每个人得到挤！ 它是庞大的， 说 Anneena。

sentences.en: "Everyone gets squeezed."
sentences.zh: 每个人笑和向。

sentences.en: They went to Trafalgar Square.
sentences.zh: 他们去到 Trafalgar 正方形。

sentences.en: On top of the column was a statue of Nelson.
sentences.zh: 在……上顶的这柱子是一个雕像的肩下握颈。

sentences.en: "I wouldn't like to be up there," said Biff.
sentences.zh: 我不会喜欢到是向上那里， 说 Biff。 哇！ 说 Biff。

sentences.en: "I don't like heights."
sentences.zh: 我不喜欢身高。

sentences.en: There were lots of pigeons in Trafalgar Square.
sentences.zh: 那里是许多的鸽子在……里 Trafalgar 正方形。

sentences.en: Gran bought some nuts.
sentences.zh: Gran 买一些疯狂的。

sentences.en: The children fed the pigeons.
sentences.zh: 这孩子们 fed 这鸽子。

sentences.en: "I'll help," "Oh help!" said Nadim.
sentences.zh: 帮助！

sentences.en: "I didn't know that pigeons were so greedy."
sentences.zh: 我没有知道那个鸽子是所以贪食的。

sentences.en: They went to Buckingham Palace.
sentences.zh: 他们去到 Buckingham 宫。

sentences.en: "This is where the Queen lives," said Gran.
sentences.zh: 这个是哪里这女王住， 说 Gran。 哦不！ 说 Gran。

sentences.en: "It's enormous," Said Anneena.
sentences.zh: 它是庞大的， 说 Anneena。

sentences.en: "The Queen must be busy with all those rooms to clean."
sentences.zh: 这女王必须是忙碌的和……一起全部那些房间到打扫。

sentences.en: A big car drove past and everyone cheered and waved.
sentences.zh: 一个大的汽车驾驶过和每个人向和波浪。

sentences.en: The children couldn't see who was inside the car.
sentences.zh: 这孩子们不能看见谁是里面这汽车。

sentences.en: "Perhaps it's the Queen," said Biff.
sentences.zh: 也许它是这女王， 说 Biff。 哇！ 说 Biff。

sentences.en: Gran took them on a boat.
sentences.zh: Gran 拿他们在……上一个船。

sentences.en: They went under Tower Bridge.
sentences.zh: 他们去在……下方塔桥梁。

sentences.en: The children were excited because the bridge began to open.
sentences.zh: 这孩子们是兴奋的因为这桥梁开始到打开。

sentences.en: It began to rain and the wind blew.
sentences.zh: 它开始到雨和这风 blew。

sentences.en: Everyone felt cold.
sentences.zh: 每个人感觉冷的。

sentences.en: "Never mind," Said Gran.
sentences.zh: 从不头脑， 说爸爸。 哦不！

sentences.en: "We'll think of somewhere warm to go next."
sentences.zh: 我们会想的在某处温暖的到去下一个。

sentences.en: They went to the Waxworks.
sentences.zh: 他们去到这蜡像馆。

sentences.en: "What is a waxworks?"
sentences.zh: 什么是一个蜡像馆？

sentences.en: Asked Kipper, as they went in.
sentences.zh: Kipper， 像他们去在……里。

sentences.en: "It has wax models of famous people," said Anneena.
sentences.zh: 它有蜂蜡模型的著名的人们， 说 Anneena。 它是庞大的， 说 Anneena。

sentences.en: They looked at the models.
sentences.zh: 他们看在这模型。

sentences.en: "Don't they look funny?" Said Kipper.
sentences.zh: 不他们看有趣的？ 说 Kipper。 哦帮助， 说 Kipper。

sentences.en: "You can tell they are models and not real people," said Anneena.
sentences.zh: 你能告诉他们是模型和不真的人们， 说 Anneena。 它是庞大的， 说 Anneena。 什么是他们？ 问 Kipper。

sentences.en: "Who are these people?"
sentences.zh: 谁是这些人们？ 问 Kipper。

sentences.en: "That is Queen Victoria," Said Gran and some of her grandchildren.
sentences.zh: Kipper， 但是将我们看见女王维多利亚？

sentences.en: "She had lots of grandchildren," said Nadim.
sentences.zh: 她有许多的孙子， 说 Nadim。 哦不！ 说 Nadim。 哇！

sentences.en: "Queen Victoria looks very fierce," said Biff.
sentences.zh: 女王维多利亚看非常凶猛的， 说 Biff。

sentences.en: "I bet she wasn't like you, Gran."
sentences.zh: 我赌她不是喜欢你， Gran。

sentences.en: "Well, I wouldn't like to be a queen," said Gran.
sentences.zh: 我不会喜欢到是一个女王， 说 Gran。 哦不！ 说 Gran。

sentences.en: "It must be a hard job."
sentences.zh: 它必须是一个困难的工作。

sentences.en: Butch Oxford Street They looked at a street scene.
sentences.zh: 他们看在一个街道场景。

sentences.en: "This is what London was like a long time ago," said Gran.
sentences.zh: 这个是什么伦敦是喜欢一个长的时间以前， 说 Gran。 哦不！ 说 Gran。

sentences.en: "A lot of people were very poor."
sentences.zh: 一个许多的人们是非常贫穷的。

sentences.en: Balk "Poor children didn't go to school in those days.
sentences.zh: 大梁贫穷的孩子们没有去到学校在……里那些一天。

sentences.en: They had to work instead," said Gran.
sentences.zh: 他们有到工作作为替代， 说 Gran。 哦不！ 说 Gran。

sentences.en: "That boy carrying brushes is a sweep.
sentences.zh: 那个男孩搬运刷子是一个清扫。

sentences.en: His job was to climb up chippneys and brush soup down."
sentences.zh: 他的工作是到爬向上烟囱和刷子煤烟子向下。

sentences.en: Gran went off to look at the Royal Family while the children stayed at the street scene.
sentences.zh: Gran 去离开到看在这王室的家庭当……的时候这孩子们停留在这街道场景。

sentences.en: "Do you think Gran should go off by herself?" Said Biff.
sentences.zh: 做你想 Gran 应该去离开由她自己？ 说 Biff。 哇！

sentences.en: "She can't do much harm in here," said Chip.
sentences.zh: 她不能做许多损害在……里这里， 说 Chip。 咳！ 说 Chip。

sentences.en: Gran dropped her handbag, and some money rolled among the models.
sentences.zh: Gran 掉下她手提包， 和一些钱使滚动在这模型。

sentences.en: Gran went to pick it up.
sentences.zh: Gran 去到挑选它向上。

sentences.en: As she bent down she knocked into the waxworks and they began to fall over.
sentences.zh: 像她弯曲的向下她碰撞进入这蜡像馆和他们开始到落下在……上方。

sentences.en: Gran picked the models up and put the heads back on.
sentences.zh: Gran 挑选这模型向上和放这正面回来在……上。

sentences.en: The children couldn't believe it.
sentences.zh: 这孩子们不能相信它。

sentences.en: What are you doing?" Said Biff.
sentences.zh: 什么有你做完？ 哇！ 说 Biff。 哦不！

sentences.en: "Don't just stand there," said Gran.
sentences.zh: 不刚刚站那里， 说 Gran。

sentences.en: "Help me.
sentences.zh: 帮助我。

sentences.en: Pick the models up before anyone sees." "Oh, Gran," Said Biff.
sentences.zh: 挑选这模型向上在……之前任何人看见。 Gran！ 哇！ 说 Biff。

sentences.en: "I let you out of my sight for a second, and this happens." Said Anneena.
sentences.zh: 我让你出的我的视力为了一个第二， 和这个发生。 它是庞大的， 说 Anneena。

sentences.en: They picked the models up and put the heads back on.
sentences.zh: 他们挑选这模型向上和放这正面回来在……上。

sentences.en: "They look strange," said Anneena.
sentences.zh: 他们看奇怪的， 说 Anneena。

sentences.en: "I don't think the heads are right." "Oh no!" Said Gran.
sentences.zh: 我不想这正面是正确的。 哦不！ 说 Gran。

sentences.en: Way out A lady ran up.
sentences.zh: 一个女士跑向上。

sentences.en: She was very cross with Gran.
sentences.zh: 她是非常叉形和……一起 Gran。

sentences.en: "I can't think how you knocked the models over in the first place," she said.
sentences.zh: 我不能想如何你碰撞这模型在……上方在……里这第一地方， 她说。

sentences.en: "It's never happened before."
sentences.zh: 它是从不发生在……之前。

sentences.en: "I'm very sorry," said Gran.
sentences.zh: 我是非常对不起， 说 Gran。 哦不！ 说 Gran。

sentences.en: "I don't know," Said Biff.
sentences.zh: 我不知道， 说 Biff。 哇！ 说 Biff。

sentences.en: "I don't think they will let Gran in the waxworks again." "Never mind," Said Chip.
sentences.zh: 我不想他们将让 Gran 在……里这蜡像馆再一次。 从不头脑， 说爸爸。 咳！

sentences.en: "Gran didn't mean to knock them over."
sentences.zh: Gran 没有意思是到碰撞他们在……上方。

sentences.en: "Thank you for a great day out," Said Nadim.
sentences.zh: 公园不谢谢你为了一个很棒的一天出， 说 Nadim。 哦不！ 说 Nadim。

sentences.en: "We had never been to London before."
sentences.zh: 我们有从不是到伦敦在……之前。

sentences.en: "I liked the ride on the boat best," said Kipper.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢这骑在……上这船最好的， 说 Kipper。 哦帮助， 说 Kipper。

sentences.en: "Even if it was cold."
sentences.zh: 竟然如果它是冷的。

sentences.en: "I liked everything," said Anneena.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢一切， 说 Anneena。 它是庞大的， 说 Anneena。

sentences.en: "Home at last," Said Gran.
sentences.zh: 他帽子这个。 哦不！ 说 Gran。

sentences.en: "We can tell Mum some of our adventures."
sentences.zh: 我们不能离开他 stuck 在……里一个冒险。

sentences.en: "But not all of them and not the one about beheading the Queen."
sentences.zh: 我们能告诉妈妈一些的我们的冒险， 但是不全部的他们。。。 和不这一关于砍掉这女王。
